name: Unofficial Apple Music for macOS
description: Ask for a playlist. Get a real one, playing in Apple Music — no account, nothing stored.
author: jaminben

tools.name: playback
tools.description: Play, pause, skip, seek, shuffle and repeat in the Music app, and report what is playing.

tools.name: library
tools.description: Search and browse your own library, add music to it, rate tracks, and export or snapshot it.

tools.name: playlist
tools.description: Create, rename and delete playlists and folders, and add or remove tracks — including tracks you do not own yet.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Search the Apple Music catalog, look up songs, albums and artists, and resolve tracks by ISRC.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Personalised recommendations, heavy rotation, charts, similar artists and top songs.

tools.name: config
tools.description: Preferences, cache, and the one-time Apple Music permission prompt.
